response.description: Azure Premium SSD v2 is now available in South India (a region without Availability Zone).Azure Premium SSD v2 disk, a next-generation general-purpose block storage option for Azure virtual machines, offers sub-millisecond latencies and exceptional price performance for IO-intensive workloads at a low cost. Premium SSD v2 is suited for a broad range of enterprise production scenarios, including SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, SAP, Cassandra, MongoDB, big data/analytics, and gaming on virtual machines or stateful containers.If Premium SSD v2 is unavailable in your preferred region and you would like to use it, please complete this survey. Learn more:Read the documentation.For more information about Premium SSD v2 Disk Storage pricing, visit the Azure Disks pricing page.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Premium SSD v2 Disk is now available in South India
